summary: test(functional-tests): add end-to-end v2 pairing coverage
description:
Because:
- The v2 pairing flow shipped without end-to-end coverage.
- The v2 supplicant runs real web-channel commands, so it cannot be a Playwright
  page.

This commit:
- Adds pairingFlowV2Android, driving a Marionette authority and a real Fenix
  supplicant with nothing stubbed.
- Adds pairingFlowV2, driving both halves over Marionette, standing in only for
  the supplicant's user agent and its oauth_login handler, which desktop chrome
  does not implement for a supplicant.
- Adds a marionetteSupplicant fixture and a v2-capable Firefox resolver.
- Extends pairChoice with v2 version negotiation.
- Adds the data-testid hooks these specs drive.
